children: Investors expect stocks to be the best-performing asset class in 2027, according to Bank of America's global fund manager survey for November. Among respondents, 36% said international stocks would perform best, followed by U.S. stocks (24%) and gold (17%). The Japanese yen is expected to be the best-performing currency, according to 42% of survey respondents. They see the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield at 4.9% by the end of 2027. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
